name: zilean
description: Connect Claude Code to a Zilean instance over MCP with browser sign-in, pause and resume its automation from slash commands, and wait for running work to drain before maintenance.

url.title: Zilean MCP endpoint URL
url.description: The full MCP endpoint of your Zilean instance, for example https://zilean.example.com/mcp. Do not include a token: a browser window opens for sign-in.
